cases.prompt: Review only; do not modify files or execute code. An existing Spring Boot 4.1.1 application uses Java21 source and explicit configuration factories. Configuration A has @Configuration, @Bean ExecutorService auditExecutor(){ return Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(); }, and @Bean AuditSink sink(){ return new AuditSink(auditExecutor()); }. The executor bean is intended to be owned/closed by the application context. Configuration B is otherwise identical but sink(ExecutorService auditExecutor) passes the parameter to AuditSink and contains no calls to another @Bean method. A proposed performance cleanup sets proxyBeanMethods=false in both. Separately export.flush-delay=5s in application.yml, the active ops profile sets10s and deployment exports EXPORT_FLUSH_DELAY=30s; the running app reports30s. The ticket requests change application.yml to2s to make ops flush faster. The same PR proposes excluding all health dependencies from readiness because liveness restarts are too frequent. Give prioritized findings, a recommendation for each configuration, the smallest meaningful verification and any information actually needed. Assume no runtime is available to you.
criteria: A: preserve full proxy or parameter-refactor before disabling; explain second unmanaged executor identity/lifecycle risk without claiming measured performance.
B: false appropriate for independent parameter factories; no forced new abstraction or @Autowired.
Config: identifies environment as effective winner; YAML-only edit won't meet target; inspect ownership/source rather than asking user to repeat values.
Health: distinguish liveness from readiness, investigate actual probes/dependency criticality; no universal remove-all readiness dependency rule.
Scope: findings only, no execution claims, tests for identity/closure/binding and real probe behavior.
cases.evaluationNote: The control run correctly identified an extra uncertainty: canonical env spelling for export.flush-delay is EXPORT_FLUSHDELAY; the task's reported30s alone does not prove how EXPORT_FLUSH_DELAY binds. Accept explicit binding/origin verification instead of asserting that spelling universally binds. The input and original criteria remain retained; this nuance will be applied equally to both conditions, and does not change the expected YAML-only failure.

cases.prompt: Review only; do not edit or run code. A Boot4.1.1 MVC application uses springdoc3.1.1 and Swagger UI. POST /api/parcels requires recipient and accepts optional deliveryInstructions, metadata{language,gateCode}, and enum deliveryMode; server-generated trackingId appears only in responses. PATCH /api/parcels/{id} treats missing deliveryInstructions as preserve and explicit null as clear. An inherited GET mapping returns an empty page as valid. Docs include only required DTO fields, a single200 Object response, and @Schema(required=true) copied from create into patch. Runtime create returns201 with Location, duplicate external reference409, validation400 with a list of violations (a field may have two), and DELETE204 with no body. Security filter emits401/403 in a different shape than ControllerAdvice. Global bearer security is declared; /api/status is public and /api/export accepts EITHER bearer OR X-Export-Key; in deployment variant B export requires BOTH. Default and partner OpenAPI groups exist; an OpenApiCustomizer bean adds headers only to the default document. A parser accepts the JSON and the team wants to claim100% coverage without opening UI or checking HTTP. Give prioritized gaps, explain the A/B security representation change, required documentation improvements including optional fields/examples, and a concrete completion check. No runtime is available.

cases.prompt: Review only; no file edits or database access. Boot4.1.1 service uses Hibernate7.4.5.Final, SQL Server and four replicas with Hikari max20 each. Customer note contains漢字 and emoji. status supports0..255. Proposed mapping uses Java Byte with @JdbcTypeCode(TINYINT), legacy non-UTF8 varchar(120) and global sendStringParametersAsUnicode=false. IDs use @SequenceGenerator(allocationSize=50) with pooled-lo, but production sequence INCREMENT BY1 is shared with another writer. Provider_disables_autocommit=true is proposed for a custom DataSource whose returned autoCommit state is unknown. List endpoint A needs pageable records plus one to-one category, retaining records with no category and total count. Variant B also needs all to-many shipmentEvents per record. Proposed universalfix is collection JOIN FETCH in pageable findAll. Writes use getReferenceById(accountId) as proof tenant authorization, @Transactional(readOnly=true) as write protection and PESSIMISTIC_WRITE as a query performance hint. Inside the transaction there is a slow remote carrier call. The author says250ms Hikari acquire timeout +virtualthreads solves latency and requests a production-ready verdict. Give prioritized findings, A/Bfetch recommendations, how to preserve atomicity while limiting transaction duration, and smallest decisive verification. Retain an existing JdbcClient path if it already satisfies a separate simple-report requirement.
criteria: Range and Unicode: Byte mismatch0..255; Java/JDBC/schema/collation/binding roundtrip; no universal unicode-off fix.
IDs: allocation/optimizer/physicalincrement/multiplewriters migration compatibility; no gap-free or commit-order promises.
Pool: provider_disables_autocommit assertion verify actualstate;20x4 globalbudget;250minimum acquisition not SQLdeadline; VT not DBcapacity.
Fetch A vsB changes: preserve missingassociations/totalcount; pagedcollectionjoin may break cardinality/inmemory; boundedtwo-stage/projection/batch alternative.
Reference/auth/readOnly/lock: reference does not prove existence/tenant; readOnlyhint; actual txnlock SQL semantics not genericoptimization.
Transactions: short atomicDBunit with dependent decisions; remote calls separately orchestrated/recovery no arbitrary split perrepository nor assume remote atomic.
